نتخادم (form VI)
# نَتَخَادَمُ (nataḵādamu) /na.ta.xaː.da.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
# نَتَخَادَمَ (nataḵādama) /na.ta.xaː.da.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
# نَتَخَادَمْ (nataḵādam) /na.ta.xaː.dam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
